offering_description.value: Provides finished-vehicle logistics, transporting new cars and light trucks by truck from ports, rail ramps and plants to dealerships. Serves automakers and other vehicle shippers using car-hauler fleets operated by company drivers and independent contractors.

primary_services.value: finished vehicle transportation; car-hauler trucking; vehicle delivery to dealerships; port and rail ramp vehicle logistics

customer_segment.value: B2B: automakers, vehicle importers, dealerships and remarketing/auction companies

revenue_model.value: service fees: freight charges per vehicle or load delivered, plus fuel surcharges

value_chain_position.value: service provider: motor carrier moving finished vehicles from plants, ports and rail ramps to dealerships for automakers; asset operator: operates fleet of car-hauler trucks and trailers and terminals

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada

specialization.value: niche specialist: finished vehicle auto hauling

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: contracts directly with automakers and vehicle shippers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: motor carrier safety, hours-of-service and emissions rules from FMCSA, DOT and state agencies

notes: Limited detail known; the company was formed recently, so scope and customers are partly uncertain.
